_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Ham & Vegetable Chowder Soup
items.label: Soup of the Week
items.description: Slow-simmered ham with potatoes, carrots, and onion in a lightly creamy broth. Hearty, comforting, and made for a winter evening.

items.name: Roasted Turkey & Swiss Press
items.label: Weekly Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Warm roasted turkey, baby Swiss, and herb butter, pressed crisp on our house bread. Balanced, savory, and satisfying without feeling heavy.
notes: Served with pickle + Weekly Side (changes weekly)

items.name: Weekly Side: Warm Red Pepper & Onion Farro
items.label: Weekly Side
items.description: Nutty farro tossed with roasted red pepper, softened red onion, olive oil, and herbs. Served warm with all pressed sandwiches and included with every combo.

items.name: Dutch Apple Cake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Classic apple cake with cinnamon and vanilla, served by the slice.
